### Style (from watching her videos)
- Who she is on camera: mom, fit, dark hair pulled back, big black sunglasses, white tank with brown leggings, gold jewellery, pink Yeti tumbler. Baby girl around 10 to 12 months with a big black bow and a knit romper. Setting: the front porch of a modern farmhouse (wood double doors, US flag, topiaries). Sling is Leopard.
- Format: polished yapper, confident TikTok Shop sales delivery, smiley and upbeat, 17 to 21s. Tight structure: hook, 3 features (padded strap, adjustable, prints), fold it into a tiny bundle to show it fits in her purse, close up of the buckle and strap, sale plus restock CTA.
- Hooks (quote): "Moms, if you have a clingy baby but you don't want to wear one of those big bulky baby carriers, I found the Best Sling Carrier by Bambora."; "This is for the moms that don't want to wear one of those big, bulky baby carriers."
- What worked: both approved and both running: 8ae9bb0e (Sep 4) 1 ad, efe9f7f6 (Sep 8) 2 ads. Her minimalist, aesthetic "fits in my purse" angle is our strongest-converting voice in this batch.
- Safety and checklist issues seen:
  - Both videos: she holds and sips from a tumbler while baby is in the sling (8ae9bb0e at 1s drinking, 4s and 7s holding it). The checklist says no drinks while filming because other parents copy what they see; it looks like a cold tumbler, but best avoided.
  - efe9f7f6 at 12s: baby on her hip with one arm around; hand stays on at 15s while holding the tumbler. OK.
  - Seat is under the bottom in both, legs hang down, which is fine for a toddler.
  - Baby looks grumpy or fussing in a few frames (8ae9bb0e at 7s, efe9f7f6 at 3s).
- Strengths to lean on: pro level scripting and delivery, strong aesthetic and minimalist positioning, fast pacing, fold-up demo.
- To improve: drop the tumbler in shot; give her new angles (wrist and arm relief) since both scripts are the same bulky carrier angle.
